'''Code burning''' was a tactic used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] to stay one step ahead of [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]]. The tactic was an expensive one, as it involved the pirates routinely switching ships to stay ahead of updates in [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder code]] logs, either through purchase or theft. Another method was to replace the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Power plant/Legends|power plant]].<ref name="PP" />
